messages:
Maya: After upgrading node-sdk to v7 our chat stream sometimes returns half messages and JSON.parse fails.
Sam: which endpoint — chat.stream or completions.stream?
Maya: chat.stream. We iterate the response and feed a length-prefixed parser we've had since v5.
Oliver: ah v7 switched stream framing to NDJSON (newline-delimited events). length-prefixed framing removed for streams.
Maya: any quick migration pattern? I don't want to rewrite our whole parser.
Kevin: use the built-in event iterator: `for await (const ev of res.events()) { ... }` — it yields parsed objects (type, fragment, done).
Maya: nice. can that interoperate with our backpressure logic (we call stream.pause/resume)?
Sam: Node streams pooling changed. v7 exposes async iterators; you should use AbortController for cancellation/backpressure now — `controller.abort()` shuts the iterator and socket.
Oliver: also note retries: streaming calls aren't retried. Non-streaming calls use idempotency keys by default; add `Idempotency-Key` header for safe retriable ops.
Maya: what about auth rotation? we rotate API keys every hour.
Kevin: v6 auto-read env on each request; v7 doesn't. Pass a token provider function instead: `new Client({ apiKey: async () => await vault.fetch('redwood_key') })`.
Maya: good call. Will do that for our token refresher.
Sam: python has similar change: `client.stream().events()` renamed to `iter_events()` in py, plus token callback accepted as `api_key_callable`.
Oliver: Go client exposes `StreamEvents(ctx)` which returns a channel of parsed events — framing aligned with NDJSON too.
Maya: any gotchas for partial JSON fragments when you still have old parser in prod?
Kevin: if you're seeing `Unexpected end of JSON input` it's almost always leftover length-pref parser. Quick patch: split on `\n` and JSON.parse each non-empty line until you move to SDK helper.
Maya: thanks. I'll try `res.events()` + token provider + add idempotency keys on non-stream retries. Will report back.
devex-bot: Migration notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/458 — includes node/python/go examples and a compatibility table. :bookmark_tabs:
Maya: saved. pinging if anything else breaks :thumbsup:
